设计意图： Preserves the core dollar imbalance relative to volatility range, but replaces rank normalization with rolling z-score to improve linear correlation (IC) while maintaining the economic mechanism. The z-score may better capture cross-sectional ordering than rank pct in this context.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(((close - (high+low+close)/3) * volume) / ts_mean(20, high-low) -> rolling_zscore(20))
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

输入字段

字段含义说明

算子

算子含义
ts_meants_mean(x, n) → x 在过去 n 天的滚动均值 (rolling mean)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_dollar_pressure_range_zscore(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] typical_price = (high + low + close) / 3 dollar_imbalance = (close - typical_price) * volume range_ = high - low range_mean = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0, np.nan) raw = dollar_imbalance / range_mean raw_mean = raw.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() raw_std = raw.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1) zscore = (raw - raw_mean) / raw_std.replace(0, np.nan) df_copy["str">'factor_dollar_pressure_range_zscore'] = zscore "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_dollar_pressure_range_zscore']
